attr.title: Modern Combat 3: Fallen Nation
attr.desc: The 2011 Modern Combat 3: Fallen Nation mobile first-person shooter by Gameloft, running its original Android ARM library directly on Linux through a bionic/JNI compatibility loader.
attr.inst: Supply your own Modern Combat 3 v1.1.7g APK plus its two OBB expansion files (main.1120 and patch.11428). Put them in ports/mc3/; the donor filenames do not matter and the first launch extracts and validates them automatically. Keep the port release named mc3-native-arm.zip. Wait for PortMaster's Finished running autoinstall dialog, then reboot normally before looking for the game in Ports. The supported native-library SHA1 is be0d5e8779899e081a538b3930ec711d2df8aeb4. No game data is included. Display resolution is detected automatically; put WIDTHxHEIGHT in resolution.txt to override it.
